summary: Tested (1) bulk autofatture in POST /api/contabilita/rigenera and the Prima nota toast, and (2) the compact (icons-only) desktop sidebar. Backend: the new pytest suite passed 10/10 and the iteration89 regression passed 9/9. Covered cases: TD16 for an IT supplier with N6.3; TD17 for a DE supplier with a 0% N2.2 line and no imposta, at aliquota_rc 10; TD17 for an IT supplier whose party has gestione_iva=extra_ue; no autofattura for an ordinary invoice; numbering AF1..AF3/anno with sezionale AF and status bozza; cedente nazione DE/IT; autofattura_id/numero on the passive invoice; rerunning with ricrea false and with ricrea true created no duplicates; drafts show in the invoices list. UI: toast 'Registrate 0 vendite, 4 acquisti, 0 movimenti bancari, create 3 autofatture da inviare allo SDI' checked. Compact sidebar: width 256->64px; main padding-left 256->64px; nav links show icons only with title tooltips; guida/change-password/logout icon buttons work; pin button hidden; localStorage nav_compact persists after reload; expands back. Pin/auto-hide (rail and floating) still works and mobile is unchanged.

minor.issue: A TD17 is created for an Italian supplier (fornitore nazione/paese_iva IT) when only the party's gestione_iva is intra_ue/extra_ue. The cedente gets nazione IT. SDI rejects TD17/TD18 when the cedente IdPaese is IT (error 00473), so this autofattura will be scartata. Either skip the autofattura and report it in errori, or require a non-IT fornitore country.

The passive invoice is set to registrata before crea_autofattura runs. If the autofattura fails, the error only goes into errori, and later runs never retry because the doc is no longer da_registrare. The user has to create it manually with POST /api/passive/{id}/autofattura.

Libro giornale numbering has gaps. A fresh company with 4 uploaded passive invoices got entries 5/2026 to 8/2026 after rigenera, so the coge counter had already been incremented (probably provisional entries cancelled and re-created). Not part of this feature; please check.

issues: There is no company switcher and no Fatturazione/Archivio area switch in compact mode: the user must expand the sidebar to change company.

Several nav items share the same icon (History: Storico F24 and Codici tributo; Calculator: Liquidazione IVA, Registrazione veloce and MRP; FileSpreadsheet: Schede contabili and Importazione), so in icons-only mode they can only be told apart by the tooltip.

There are 45 icons in a 1080px viewport (scrollHeight 2170), so Guida/Cambia password/Esci are only reachable after scrolling to the bottom. Consider keeping the bottom buttons sticky, or showing only the active group's icons.
The FE badge looks slightly squeezed in the 64px column.

action_items: Optional: skip TD17 creation (and report it in errori) when the fornitore is Italian and only the party gestione_iva says intra/extra UE, or warn the user.
Optional: make rigenera retry missing autofatture for docs with registrata_auto, reverse_charge set and no autofattura_id.
Optional UX: in compact mode add the company switcher (icon popover) and keep the bottom buttons sticky.
critical_code_review_comments: contabilita.py rigenera: tipo_af comes from proposta_tipo(full), which uses full.estero, so a party gestione_iva extra_ue gives TD17 even when the fornitore is IT (see the minor backend issue).
contabilita.py is 762 lines, more than the 700-line limit: consider splitting the rigenera and mastrini sections.
Layout.jsx: the nav item filter expression is duplicated in the compact and full SideContent branches; extract it into a helper.
seed_data_creation: A TEST_T91 company, user and session were created via fixtures and mongosh, then fully cleaned up. No TEST_T90/T91 companies are left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration91 reuses the iteration89 pattern (mongosh session token, TEST_ company, aliquota_rc=10). Set T91_KEEP=1 with -k test_01 to keep da_registrare docs for UI testing. Browser auth: add cookie session_token=<TOK> plus localStorage fe_company_id. The Prima nota rigenera button (coge-rigenera-btn) opens a window.confirm, so accept the dialog.
